svg.title: Rail-optimized Spectrum-X scalable unit: 32 DGX nodes × 8 SuperNICs = 8 rails
svg.text: Rail-optimized Spectrum-X scalable unit: 32 DGX nodes × 8 SuperNICs = 8 rails
NIC n of every node → leaf n. Same-rail traffic is one hop; cross-rail traffic crosses the spines (AR).
Per leaf: 16 × 800G up = 12.8 Tb/s; 32 × 400G down = 12.8 Tb/s → 1:1 non-blocking (2:1 halves uplinks).
Per SU: 32 nodes × 8 NICs × 400G = 102.4 Tb/s host bandwidth = 128 × 800G leaf ports after breakout.
Orange: NIC 3 of every node lands on leaf03, so GPU 3 ↔ GPU 3 all-reduce never leaves the leaf.
Grey: NIC 8 → leaf08. Cross-rail traffic goes via the spines; mgmt/storage are a separate network.
